items.exampleEn: I'm convinced that she is telling the truth.
The teacher gave us a hint about what would be on the test.
items.exampleZh: 老師給了我們一點關於考試範圍的暗示。

items.exampleEn: "Time is money" is a common metaphor.
items.exampleZh: 「時間就是金錢」是常見的隱喻。

items.exampleEn: The cat sat by the window, intent on watching the birds.
items.exampleZh: 那隻貓坐在窗邊，專心盯著鳥兒看。

items.exampleEn: I'm in a dilemma: should I take the new job or stay?
items.exampleZh: 我陷入兩難：該接受新工作，還是留下來？

items.exampleEn: It's hard to conceive of life without phones.
items.exampleZh: 很難想像沒有手機的生活。

items.exampleEn: The revelation that the manager was leaving surprised everyone.
items.exampleZh: 經理要離職的消息曝光，讓大家都很驚訝。

items.exampleEn: He finally conceded that he had made a mistake.
items.exampleZh: 他終於承認自己犯了錯。

items.sentenceEn: After a long discussion, she conceded that my plan was better.
items.sentenceZh: 經過長時間討論，她承認我的計畫比較好。

items.audioEn: Here's a hint: the answer is something you use every day in the kitchen.
items.audioZh: 給你一個提示：答案是你每天在廚房會用到的東西。

items.sentenceEn: The writer uses the sea as a metaphor for freedom.
items.sentenceZh: 作者用大海來比喻自由。

items.sentenceEn: Her friends were convinced that her small cafe would be a success.
items.sentenceZh: 她的朋友們深信她的小咖啡店會成功。

items.stemEn: Parents often face a ____ when their child wants a pet but their apartment is small.
items.stemZh: 孩子想養寵物、但公寓又很小時，父母常陷入兩難。

items.stemEn: The young designer was ____ on winning the prize, so she worked every weekend.
items.stemZh: 那位年輕設計師一心想得獎，所以每個週末都在工作。

items.passageEn: Our book club recently read a novel about a young woman facing a difficult dilemma: whether to take over her father's small shop or follow her dream of becoming a painter. At first, she is intent on leaving her hometown. The writer gives readers small hints that she will change her mind, and the old shop becomes a metaphor for family. Near the end, there is a surprising revelation: her father had once given up his own dream for her. Some members found it hard to conceive of making such a choice. One member, who had disliked the book at first, conceded that the ending was superb. Everyone was convinced it was the best book we had read this year.
items.passageZh: 我們的讀書會最近讀了一本小說，講一位年輕女子面臨艱難的兩難：要接手父親的小店，還是追求當畫家的夢想。一開始，她一心想離開家鄉。作者給了讀者一些小小的暗示，透露她會改變心意，而那家老店也成了家庭的隱喻。接近結尾時，出現一個令人驚訝的揭露：她父親曾經為了她放棄自己的夢想。有些成員很難想像自己做出這樣的選擇。一位起初不喜歡這本書的成員也承認結局非常出色。大家都深信這是我們今年讀過最好的一本書。

options: 要在城裡買房子，還是繼續租房子
搬去國外工作，還是留在台灣的家鄉
早點結婚，還是去大學繼續讀書
接手父親的店，還是去當畫家

questions.questionZh: 故事接近結尾時揭露了什麼？
options: 她其實一點都不會畫畫
父親早就打算把那家老店賣掉了
她父親以前是有名的畫家

items.promptZh: 經理深信這個新產品會賣得很好。
referenceEn: The manager is convinced that this new product will sell well.
The manager is convinced the new product will sell well.
rubricZh: convinced 表示「深信」，例如 be convinced (that)… 等
寫 is sure… 這類意思相近的說法也可以

items.promptZh: 這道湯裡有一點點檸檬的味道。
referenceEn: This soup has a hint of lemon.
There is a hint of lemon in this soup.
rubricZh: hint 在這裡指「一點點（味道）」（例如 a hint of lemon 等）
「湯裡有」可寫，例如 This soup has、There is … in this soup 等
